description: This file provides utility functions for transforming and processing data related to roles, competencies, levels, and their relationships within a career pathway project. It includes functions to normalize skill levels, build seed data for roles and competencies, parse scores, and convert name-based relationships into ID-based records.

methods.name: Optional[str] normalize_level(level_raw: str)
methods.description: Maps raw string representations of skill levels into standardized categories: 'beginner', 'intermediate', 'advanced'.

methods.name: Tuple[List[Dict],List[Dict],List[Dict]] build_from_competency_mapping( mapping_df: pd.DataFrame, limit: Optional[int] = None )
methods.description: Generates seed data for competencies, roles, and role-competency associations from a pandas DataFrame.

methods.name: List[Dict] build_roles_from_cards( role_cards: Iterable[Dict[str, str]], existing_roles: Optional[Iterable[str]] = None, )
methods.description: Creates role entries from parsed role card dictionaries, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: Optional[float] _parse_score(value)
methods.description: Parses a value to extract a numerical score, handling percentages and fractional scores.

methods.name: List[Dict] build_role_adjacency_records( adjacency_df: pd.DataFrame, limit: Optional[int] = None )
methods.description: Builds role adjacency records from a DataFrame representing role relationships.

methods.name: List[Dict] attach_ids_for_relationships( role_competencies: List[Dict], role_name_to_id: Dict[str, int], competency_name_to_id: Dict[str, int], )
methods.description: Converts role and competency name associations into their respective ID-based representations.

methods.name: List[Dict] attach_ids_for_role_adjacency( role_adjacency: List[Dict], role_name_to_id: Dict[str, int], )
methods.description: Converts role adjacency relationships from name-based to ID-based representations.

ctags.name: attach_ids_for_relationships
ctags.signature: ( role_competencies: List[Dict], role_name_to_id: Dict[str, int], competency_name_to_id: Dict[str, int], )

ctags.name: build_roles_from_cards
ctags.signature: ( role_cards: Iterable[Dict[str, str]], existing_roles: Optional[Iterable[str]] = None, )
